title: Ymawky: a fully functional static HTTP web server written entirely in pure ARM64 assembly for macOS
description:
Ymawky is a fully functional static HTTP web server written entirely in pure ARM64 assembly for macOS. No external libraries, no libc, raw Darwin syscalls directly to Apple Silicon. GET, PUT, DELETE, byte-range requests, custom error pages, directory listing, Slowloris mitigation. 48-kilobyte binary. Over 1.2 million requests per second on an M3 while barely touching RAM. Technically impressive. Existentially motivated. Absolutely unhinged.

https://github.com/imtomt/ymawky
